faq.q: What is the tax treatment of FCNR(B) interest?
faq.a: Interest earned on FCNR(B) deposits is fully exempt from income tax in India for NRIs.

faq.q: Can I take a loan against my FCNR(B) deposit?
faq.a: Yes, Indian banks generally offer loans against FCNR(B) deposits, using them as collateral.

faq.q: What currencies are supported for FCNR(B)?
faq.a: Commonly supported currencies include USD, GBP, EUR, JPY, AUD, and CAD, though specific offerings may vary by bank.

faq.q: Who is eligible for FCNR(B) deposits?
faq.a: Non-Resident Indians (NRIs) and Persons of Indian Origin (PIOs) are eligible to open FCNR(B) accounts.

faq.q: What is the minimum tenure for FCNR(B)?
faq.a: The minimum tenure for FCNR(B) deposits is typically one year, with a maximum tenure of five years.

faq.q: How does currency fluctuation impact this strategy?
faq.a: Currency fluctuations between the FCNR(B) deposit currency (e.g., USD) and the loan currency (INR) can significantly impact the effective cost of the loan and the overall profitability of the leveraged investment.
